walkthrough.formula: Take any model M of ∃x ∀y Sibling(x,y).
walkthrough.explanation: Choose a witness a: it is related by Sibling to every domain object.

walkthrough.formula: Let d be an arbitrary object of the domain.
walkthrough.explanation: The witness a has already been chosen. It works for this choice of d too.
The universal claim about a applies to d.
Choose a as the existential witness.
The choice of d was arbitrary, and M was any model of the premise.
